name: New Balance SLC — hand-stack pick racking (copy of Ontario, CA schema)
drawing: 25-1642-R02RE Rev C 'VNA Racking Plan View' (FOR PERMIT 6/15/2026)

site.address: 2335 W 2950 N Suite 1, Salt Lake City, UT 84116

building.notes: 806,000 sf New Balance DC (opened Oct 2025) within a ~1.14M sf development. ~50 ft clear is the team's estimate; no public spec found.

fire.commodity_note: Cartoned athletic footwear (NBAS cases). EVA/rubber/synthetic content may push to cartoned unexpanded Group A plastic (CUP).
fire.storage_height_note: Estimate: ~26'-6" top beam + 31.5" case. Confirm from revised elevations.
fire.flues_note: Design intent: upright | 3" | case | 6" | case | 3" | upright. Hand-stack operations must actually hold these.

rack.schema: Single-row hand-stack runs tied across the 5'-10" aisle with cross-aisle tie beams (as built at Ontario, CA).
rack.notes: As drawn, clear openings (~31-34 in.) do not fit a 31.5 in. case + 6/12 in. clearance; pitches must open up.

open_questions: Confirmed ceiling and sprinkler DEFLECTOR height (drives ESFR 45 ft ceiling limit and 36 in. clearance).
Insurer — FM Global? (FM DS 8-9 would govern.)
Commodity classification of the footwear cases (Class IV vs cartoned Group A).
Wire deck open-area % and whether hand-stackers will hold the 3/6/3 in. flues.
Shelf load per level per bay (lb) for beam/frame selection.
How the Ontario, CA building was classified and protected, and what its AHJ/insurer accepted.
history: 2026-10: Utah adopted editions confirmed (NFPA 13 2019, IFC 2021, ASCE 7-16).
2026-10: Cross-aisle ties + 5'-10"/6'-0" aisles do not by themselves force in-rack; solid-shelf status and ceiling height do.

2026-10: NFPA 13 ceiling-only ESFR is limited to a 45 ft ceiling (Class I-IV/CUP). At ~50 ft, specific-application listings (P25/VK514, 48 ft) don't reach and FM K28 needs 8 ft aisles -> in-rack likely. With open decks, EC/ESFR in-rack needs one level >= 5 ft up as a 'virtual floor' (fire_check). If the deflector is <= 45-48 ft, ceiling-only may work.
2026-10: ESFR deflector-to-storage clearance is 36 in. (not 18 in.).
